mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( receiver_id, sender_id, content, community_id, is_read, created_at ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{communityId}, #{isRead}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, receiver_id, sender_id, content, community_id, is_read, created_at FROM notification WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = true WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
